title: 情景应用文的结构
goal: 按收件人和任务确定交际目的；选出符合交际目的的正文结构。

points.label: 按收件人和任务确定交际目的
选出符合交际目的的正文结构

sources.title: 大学英语六级（CET-6）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分：情景应用文的结构；内容范围、知识点与客观题规格。

cards.title: 结构：建议信
rows: 称呼
写给能处理这件事的人。
Dear Workshop Coordinator,
目的句
说明写信是为了提出改进建议。
I am writing to suggest a clearer system for collecting finished prints.
具体事项
问题、措施和预期作用一一对应。
Numbered folders would let participants locate their own prints without moving others.
结尾
请对方考虑或讨论，不写成措施已经执行。
Thank you for considering this suggestion. Kind regards, Lin

cards.title: 结构：邀请信
rows: 称呼
称呼受邀者，不写成组织者的名字。
Dear Dr. Vega,
目的句
写明邀请参加什么活动、承担什么角色。
The astronomy club would like to invite an introductory talk on observation notes.
具体事项
写清活动目的、时间地点和请对方做的事。
The talk is planned for 12 March at 7 p.m. in the neighborhood learning room.
结尾
请对方答复能否参加，不写成对方已经同意。
Please confirm availability by 1 March. Best regards, Lin

cards.title: 结构：申请信
rows: 称呼
写给负责选拔或审批的人或部门。
Dear Volunteer Selection Team,
目的句
说明申请的具体岗位或机会。
I am applying for the oral-history transcription role at the community archive.
具体事项
用经验和能力对应岗位职责，不只说自己有兴趣。
I checked uncertain names against speakers' notes while preparing transcripts.
结尾
请对方考虑或安排面谈，不写成已被录用。
I would welcome an opportunity to discuss the role. Sincerely, Lin

cards.title: 常用表达
rows: 提出建议
I would like to propose a numbered collection system for the completed prints.
propose 只是提出建议，还没有获准。
发出邀请
On behalf of the club, I am writing to invite a contribution on observation notes.
on behalf of 说明代表谁写信。
申请岗位
I am writing to apply for the advertised transcription role.
apply for 是申请，还没有得到岗位。
提供证据
My transcription sample shows how I mark uncertain passages without guessing.
证据要证明岗位需要的能力。
请求回复
A reply by 1 March would help us complete the programme.
请对方答复的是能否接受邀请。
申请后续
I would welcome an interview to discuss my suitability for the role.
请对方评估自己是否合适，不是向对方发出邀请。

body.box:
Dear Workshop Coordinator,

I am writing to suggest a clearer system for collecting finished prints from the community studio. At present, finished work is placed on a shared table without a collection list. Participants sometimes move several prints before finding their own, which makes the process slow and increases unnecessary handling.

A numbered collection folder for each participant could make the arrangement clearer. The number could appear on the collection message as well as on the folder, allowing a participant to identify the correct work without searching through other people's prints. A short list showing which folders are ready would also help the coordinator answer collection questions.

The proposal concerns collection rather than changes to the printing sessions themselves. It could be tried with the next completed group before the studio decides whether to keep it. I would welcome an opportunity to discuss the practical requirements and help prepare the numbered folders. Thank you for considering this suggestion.

Kind regards,
Lin

body.p: 建议信写给协调员。先说明取作品的困难，再提出编号文件夹和试行办法。结尾请对方考虑，没有把建议写成已经执行的通知。

body.box:
Dear Dr. Vega,

I am writing on behalf of the community astronomy club to invite a short contribution to our evening on observing the night sky. The session is planned for 12 March at 7 p.m. in the neighborhood learning room. It will be attended by adults beginning their first season of observation.

We would be grateful for an introductory talk on keeping useful observation notes. A discussion of dates, locations, and changing viewing conditions would help participants understand what to record before they begin using the club's shared notebooks. The proposed talk would last twenty minutes, followed by questions from the group.

The club will provide a projector and a table for sample notebooks. No outdoor observation is required for this session. Please let the organizing team know by 1 March whether this proposed contribution would be possible. A reply would allow us to complete the programme and confirm the room arrangement with the caretaker.

Best regards,
Lin

body.p: 邀请信的正文帮助受邀者判断能否来发言。听众、时间地点、主题和答复期限都写得很清楚。泛泛介绍对天文的兴趣，代替不了这些内容。

body.box:
Dear Volunteer Selection Team,

I am writing to apply for the oral-history transcription role advertised by the community archive. The position interests me because it combines careful listening with the preparation of records that other residents can consult. I understand that the task involves producing accurate transcripts rather than selecting which interviews will be published.

During a student project, I transcribed recorded discussions and checked uncertain names against the notes supplied by the speakers. That experience taught me to mark unclear passages instead of replacing them with guesses. I can attend the archive's Thursday training sessions and have time to complete a regular weekly transcription assignment.

I have attached a short sample showing how I distinguish a confirmed word from an uncertain passage. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss the role and learn the archive's own conventions before beginning any work. Thank you for considering my application and the attached evidence of relevant experience.

Sincerely,
Lin

body.p: 申请信用转写经历对应岗位职责，附件是可以检查的样本。收件人是选拔团队。正文是在申请岗位，不是邀请团队来参加活动。

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: 收件人错位
Dear Lin, at the start of Lin's application.
Dear Volunteer Selection Team,
目的改变
I accept the role. in an initial application.
I am applying for the role.
事项不符
An invitation gives only the speaker's past qualifications.
Add the proposed contribution, date, venue, and reply request.
结尾预设结果
Thank you for approving the new collection system.
Thank you for considering the proposed collection system.
角色颠倒
The applicant asks the selection team to submit an application.
The applicant provides evidence and requests consideration.

groups.text: Maya represents a residents' photography group. She is inviting a local curator to discuss organizing a small exhibition. The curator has not yet replied.

items.stem: Which opening matches Maya's role and purpose?
options: I am applying to become the curator of the local exhibition.
I confirm that the curator has already accepted our invitation.
I am writing for the group to invite a talk on exhibition planning.
I am writing to thank you for the talk you gave on exhibition planning.
items.why: Maya represents the group，任务是 inviting a local curator。第三项代表小组发出邀请，与此一致。

groups.text: A student is applying to a campus seed bank for a volunteer labeling role. The selection team needs evidence of careful record keeping.

items.stem: Which body detail best supports the application?
options: I checked plant labels against a dated inventory during a previous project.
The selection team is invited to label plants at my private event.
The seed bank should introduce a dated inventory for checking its plant labels.
The labeling role has already been assigned to me for the entire term.
items.why: 选拔团队 needs evidence of careful record keeping。第一项写了核对标签和清单的经历，正是这种证据。

groups.text: A passenger writes to the shuttle manager suggesting clearer notices about temporary stop changes. The route itself is not being changed.

options: I would like to suggest changing the shuttle route to avoid the temporary stops.
I would like to suggest clearer information about temporary stop locations.
I am inviting the manager to ride a newly established route.
I am confirming that all temporary stops have already been removed.
items.why: 乘客的目的是 suggesting clearer notices，路线本身不变。第二项建议改进临时站点的信息；第一项要改路线，与材料不符。

groups.text: An invitation asks a conservator to demonstrate book handling at a community event. The body explains the audience and demonstration topic but omits all scheduling details.

items.stem: Which addition fills the relevant gap?
options: A paragraph announcing that the conservator has accepted the role.
A list of qualifications needed to apply as a conservator.
A description of the audience and the book-handling topic.
The proposed date, place, and requested time for a reply.
items.why: 正文 omits all scheduling details。第四项补上日期、地点和答复时间，正好填补这一空缺。第三项的内容正文已经写了。

groups.text: A resident writes to the coordinator of a community kitchen about a confusing ingredient shelf. The purpose is to suggest labels that distinguish supplies available to all users from items reserved for a particular class. No request to join the teaching staff is intended. The coordinator can decide whether to try the labels. A suitable closing should ask for consideration and leave that decision open, rather than report that the change has already been authorized.

items.stem: Which request stays within the resident's intended purpose?
options: Please consider labels separating shared supplies from class materials.
Please consider my qualifications for joining the kitchen's teaching staff.
Please consider labels that mark every shelf item as reserved for a class.
Please confirm that the new shelf labels have already been authorized.
items.why: 居民的目的是 suggest labels that distinguish supplies，第一项与此一致。第四项把标签写成已经获批。

items.stem: Complete a closing appropriate to this suggestion.
items.tail: is made about whether to introduce them on the community kitchen's ingredient shelf.
items.why: the opportunity to discuss 是请求讨论。before a decision is made 说明还没有作决定。

groups.text: Scenario: A student called Rui represents a campus theatre society. The society is inviting Ms. Lane, a costume designer, to lead a discussion about adapting costumes for different performers. The proposed event is on 18 April in the rehearsal room, and the society needs a reply by 5 April. Ms. Lane has not yet accepted. Rui should write on behalf of the society, explain the planned contribution and practical arrangements, and ask whether the designer would be available to participate.

items.stem: Which opening keeps the recipient and purpose aligned?
options: Dear Rui, I am applying for a costume-design role in the society.
Dear Ms. Lane, I confirm the discussion that has already been accepted.
Dear Rui, I am inviting a contribution from Ms. Lane on behalf of the theatre society.
Dear Ms. Lane, I am inviting a contribution on behalf of the theatre society.
items.why: 收件人是 Ms. Lane，Rui 代表剧社发出邀请，即第四项。第三项的目的对，但称呼写成了写信人 Rui。

items.stem: Which body plan best serves this invitation?
options: Explain the discussion topic, give the date and room, then request availability by 5 April.
List Rui's design experience, attach a portfolio, then ask for selection as costume designer.
Describe the accepted discussion, report its attendance, then thank the designer for completing it.
Suggest changing all costumes, explain the costs, then announce that the proposal is approved.
items.why: 材料要求说明 planned contribution and practical arrangements，并请对方在 5 April 前答复。第一项这三部分都有。

items.stem: Express Rui's invitation without presuming acceptance.
items.lead: On behalf of the theatre society, I am writing
chunks: a discussion led by Ms. Lane
items.tail: at the proposed event in the rehearsal room on 18 April.
items.why: to invite 表明写信是为了邀请。led by Ms. Lane 说明请她做什么，没有说她已经同意。

groups.text: Scenario: A community museum is selecting volunteers to describe objects for an accessible visitor guide. A student called Hana is applying to the Visitor Access Team. Hana has experience writing clear descriptions of handmade objects and can attend the Saturday training. The application should identify the role, connect that experience with the required work, and ask for consideration. It should not invite the team to an event or assume that Hana has already been selected. A sample description may support the application.

items.stem: Which request is consistent with Hana's role?
options: An invitation asking the team to attend Hana's Saturday exhibition.
An application asking the team to consider Hana for object-description work.
A confirmation telling the team that Hana has selected the volunteers.
A suggestion asking the team to rewrite the visitor guide's object descriptions.
items.why: Hana is applying to the Visitor Access Team，信要 ask for consideration。第二项请团队考虑 Hana，与此一致。

items.stem: Connect the applicant's experience with the advertised work.
items.tail: for the accessible visitor guide, and I am available to attend the required Saturday training.
items.why: would help me prepare 把经历和岗位职责联系起来。help me 后接动词原形 prepare，不用 preparing。

groups.text: Scenario: A neighborhood sports center has asked users for suggestions about its changing-room signs. A user called Jun writes to the Facilities Team. Several signs use similar symbols for different rooms, so visitors sometimes enter the wrong room. Jun proposes adding clear words beside the symbols and testing the revised signs with visitors before permanent installation. The purpose is to recommend an improvement within the existing center, not to apply for a job or invite the team to a new sporting event.

items.stem: Which sequence best matches Jun's purpose?
options: Describe a sporting event, invite the team, then request an attendance reply.
Describe Jun's work experience at the center, provide references, then request a job interview.
Explain the sign confusion, propose word labels, then ask for a trial before installation.
Describe the finished installation, confirm approval, then thank visitors for attending.
items.why: Jun 先指出标志容易混淆，再提出加文字，并建议正式安装前先试用。第三项正是这个顺序。

items.stem: Express the user's purpose to the Facilities Team.
items.tail: so that visitors can identify the intended room without confusing similar signs at the sports center.
items.why: to recommend 表明写信是为了提出建议。that distinguish the changing rooms 修饰 symbols。

items.stem: Complete a suitable request at the end of Jun's suggestion.
items.tail: the revised signs before the center decides whether to install them permanently in the changing-room area.
items.why: consideration of a trial 是请对方考虑试行。that allows visitors to compare 说明试行的用途，allows 后接 to compare。
